args.message: The top three cities by revenue (total order amount), highest first, are Bergen (823 orders), Oslo (839 orders) and Rome (752 orders). Oslo has more orders than Bergen but less revenue. Cities come from each customer's record; 6 orders have no city and are not ranked.
